name: Silk Legacy – For Older Devices – Interactive Generative Art

ios.desc:
! This is the Legacy version of Silk for older devices. !
! Search for "Silk 2" to find the new and improved version! !

Relax, play, and create beautiful flowing art with Silk.  

With the swish of a finger, Silk strands mingle and fuse, weaving together into wonderful works of art.

"I can't believe even someone like me can create something cool looking in this thing. That's amazing!" ~ nickknw
"Awesome! All I can think is woahdude." ~ MayhemMark

* Featured by Apple in New and Noteworthy in 120+ countries
* The #1 Entertainment app in the Canada and the UK, and topping the charts worldwide

Features:

* The official app of the award-winning weavesilk.com, with millions of users.
* Original music and sound composed for the Silk experience.
* Create gorgeous wallpapers with the swish of a finger.
* Great for artists and non-artists alike.
* Cross-platform, so you can play on your iPad and iPhone/iPod touch.
